sarima.selection_note: ARMA(1,1) on the seasonally differenced log1p series. Chosen on held-out MAE and parsimony: orders 3-8 span validation MAE 136.3-137.0 (a 0.5% spread) while AIC keeps improving and is minimised by ARMA(2,2), so the extra terms buy in-sample likelihood without out-of-sample gain.

lstm.selection_note: Best validation MAE among the LSTM configurations that trained to convergence. Experiments 4-6 hit the 420 s tuning budget and are truncated rather than converged, so they are excluded from selection.

tcn.selection_note: Chosen for parsimony, not for best validation MAE. Controlled study (equal epochs, early stopping disabled) gave RF 61: 103.17, RF 125: 109.61, RF 253: 104.55, RF 509: 102.47. The ordering is non-monotonic, bounding run-to-run variation at >= 5.06 MAE with a single seed per configuration; this configuration is within that bound of the best (102.47) and is the shallowest such, so the difference is not evidence of a real effect. Substantive finding: receptive field has no systematic effect on one-step-ahead accuracy over this range.
